// Run alongside the pinned release's runtime/thread_output_external_test.go
// in a blank module. Only synthetic data from the public Runtime is retained.
package runtime_test

import (
	"fmt"
	"github.com/floegence/floret/v7/tools"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestWriteReleasedRetainedPrefix(t *testing.T) {
	f := newOutputRuntimeFixture(t, false, tools.Result{Text: `{"preview":"recorded"}`, FullOutput: &tools.FullOutputPlan{Text: strings.Repeat("synthetic retained line\n", 100)}})
	req := f.gateway.Requests()[1]
	found := false
	for _, m := range req.Messages {
		if m.ToolResult != nil && strings.Contains(m.ToolResult.Text, `"preview_omitted":true`) {
			found = true
			fmt.Printf("thread=%s read=%t\n", f.binding.ThreadID, strings.Contains(m.ToolResult.Text, `"read":`))
		}
	}
	if !found {
		t.Fatal("missing truncated retained result")
	}
	// The fixture helper reopens exactly this file. Backup includes its WAL.
	files, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(t.TempDir()), "*", "output.sqlite"))
	if err != nil || len(files) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("fixture database: %v %v", files, err)
	}
	if out, err := exec.Command("sqlite3", "-readonly", files[0], ".backup '"+os.Getenv("FIXTURE_PATH")+"'").CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("backup: %s: %v", out, err)
	}
}
